episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her insights on maintaining consistency in YouTube content production for real estate agents. She emphasizes the importance of having backup systems, such as a video bank and a secondary editor, to ensure uninterrupted content flow. Sarah also provides a structured approach to content planning and filming, highlighting the significance of discipline over motivation in sustaining a successful YouTube channel.
